title: "CDI data"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
SERVER_PATH <- "/Volumes/vislearnlab/experiments/visual-precision"
```

```{r}
cdi_level1 <- read.csv(file.path(SERVER_PATH, "data/raw/lookit/cdi/cdi_level1.csv"))
cdi_level2a <- read.csv(file.path(SERVER_PATH, "data/raw/lookit/cdi/cdi_level2a.csv"))
df1 <- cdi_level1
df2 <- cdi_level2a
view(df1)
view(df2)
names(df1)
names(df2)
```

```{r}
#delete unnecessary columns
df1 <- df1 %>% select(StartDate, ChildID, starts_with("Q"))
df2 <- df2 %>% select(StartDate, ChildID, starts_with("Q"))
```

```{r}
#get a mapping table
words <- df1[1,]
words <- pivot_longer(words, cols = !ChildID)
words$ChildID <- NULL
words <- words %>% separate(value, into=c('WordType', 'Words'), sep='-')
words <- words %>% mutate(WordType = trimws(WordType), Words = trimws(Words))
view(words)
```

```{r}
#delete metadata and testing rows
df1 <- df1[-(1:11), ]
df2 <- df2[-(1:8), ]
```

```{r}
# transform to pivot long for df1
df1_long <- df1 %>% pivot_longer(cols=!ChildID, names_to = "Question", values_to = 'Response')

df1_long <- df1_long %>% mutate(Response = trimws(Response), Response = na_if(Response, ""), Response = as.numeric(Response))

#add survey type and value
df1_long$SurveyType = '1'
df1_long$Value = ifelse(is.na(df1_long$Response), 0, 1)
```

```{r}
#check before merge words to df1_long
setdiff(df1_long$Question, words$name)

#merge
df1_long <- df1_long %>% left_join(words, c('Question' = 'name'))
df1_long %>% filter(is.na(Words)) %>% distinct(Question)

#map into condition
ability <- tibble::tibble(Response = c(NA, 1, 2), Type = c(NA, 'Understands', 'Understands and Says'))
df1_long <- df1_long %>% left_join(ability, 'Response')
```

```{r}
#process df2
df2_long <- df2 %>% pivot_longer(c(Q1, Q2, Q3), names_to = 'Question_group', values_to = 'Response') %>% separate_rows(Response, sep=',')
df2_long <- df2_long %>% mutate(Response = trimws(Response), Response = na_if(Response, ""), Response = as.numeric(Response))
```

```{r}
#get the label for df2
cdi_level2a_label <- read.csv("/Volumes/vislearnlab/experiments/visual-precision/data/raw/lookit/cdi/cdi_level2a_label.csv")
df2_label <- cdi_level2a_label
df2_label <- df2_label %>% select(ChildID, starts_with("Q"))
df2_label <- df2_label[-c(1, 2), ]

#separate choices
df2_label <- df2_label %>% pivot_longer(c(Q1, Q2, Q3), names_to = 'Question_group', values_to = 'Words') %>% separate_rows(Words, sep=',')
#colnames(df2_label)[2] <- 'combine_words'
df2_label <- df2_label %>% mutate(Words = trimws(Words), Words = na_if(Words, ""))
```

```{r}
#create order index
nrow(df2_long) == nrow(df2_label)

num <- nrow(df2_long)
ID <- c(1:num)

df2_long <- cbind(ID, df2_long)
df2_label <- cbind(ID, df2_label)

#merge
df2_long <- df2_long %>% merge(df2_label, by='ID')
```

```{r}
#clean df2_long
df2_long$Question_group.y = NULL
df2_long$ChildID.y = NULL

colnames(df2_long)[2] <- 'ChildID'
colnames(df2_long)[3] <- 'Question_group'

#add type and value column
df2_long$SurveyType = '2A'
df2_long$Value = ifelse(is.na(df2_long$Words), 0, 1)
```
